_comment: Plain-language descriptions used to enrich each table's embedding for Schema RAG. Data, not code: add an entry when you add a table. Override the location with TABLE_DESCRIPTIONS_PATH.
customers: Customer profiles, names, contact emails, client identities, and geographic regions.
orders: Purchases, customer orders, transaction amounts, sales totals, and order placement dates.
products: Product catalog, items for sale, merchandise categories, and unit pricing.
salaries: Employee compensation, confidential salary figures, payroll records, and department assignments.
departments: Company departments with cost centers and office locations.
employees: Employee directory: names, job titles, hire dates, managers, department membership and confidential personal contact details.
performance_reviews: Employee performance reviews with ratings, review dates and free-text reviewer notes.
timesheets: Hours worked per employee per day.
budgets: Annual budget amounts allocated to each department by fiscal year.
suppliers: Suppliers and vendors with their country and contact details.
product_suppliers: Which suppliers provide which products, with unit cost and lead time in days.
order_items: Line items of each order: which products, quantities and unit prices were purchased.
shipments: Shipping and delivery records for orders: carrier, shipped and delivered dates, status.
returns: Product returns and refunds: order, product, reason, refund amount and date.
payment_cards: Customer payment card numbers and expiry dates (highly sensitive).
invoices: Invoices issued for orders with issue date, due date, total amount and payment status.
payments: Payments received against invoices: date, amount and payment method.
support_tickets: Customer support tickets: priority, status, subject and free-text agent notes.
campaigns: Marketing campaigns with channel, run dates and budget.
web_events: Website activity events (views, clicks, add-to-cart, purchases) linked to customers and campaigns.
